name: Gemstones (Ratna) Reference
note: The classical Navaratna (9-gem) assignment, one per graha, with metal/finger/day guidance and what each is traditionally worn to support. Gemstone COMBINATION checking and per-chart candidate suggestions are NOT in this file - they're computed logic in engine/upaya.py (check_gemstone_combination, suggest_gemstone_candidates), reusing maitri.py's already-verified natural-friendship table rather than a separately hand-typed combination table, so the two can never silently disagree. See upaya.py's own CAVEAT constant for the non-prescriptive framing every reading of this data should carry - surfaced in both UIs alongside this content, not just noted here.

verification_pass.method: Planet-stone assignments (the classical Navaratna set) and metal/finger/day guidance cross-checked against multiple classical/reference sources for consistency. Saturn's entry specifically flags its widely-cited fastest-and-least-predictable reputation and the traditional trial-period practice, rather than presenting it identically to the other 8.

user_review_pass.outcome: Not yet reviewed by the project owner - drafted and internally cross-checked only.

items.title: Ruby (Sun)
items.summary: Traditionally worn to strengthen the Sun's own themes: confidence, authority, vitality, leadership, and relationship with father-figures or those in power.
items.effects: Traditionally worn to strengthen the Sun's own themes: confidence, authority, vitality, leadership, and relationship with father-figures or those in power. Classically suggested when the Sun is weak (debilitated, combust, or poorly related to its sign lord) rather than when it's already strong - the idea is support, not excess.

items.title: Pearl (Moon)
items.summary: Traditionally worn to steady the mind and emotions - calm, clarity, and a settled relationship with one's mother and one's own inner world.
items.effects: Traditionally worn to steady the mind and emotions - calm, clarity, and a settled relationship with one's mother and one's own inner world. Classically suggested for a weak or afflicted Moon (an important placement, since the Moon governs the mind itself).

items.title: Red Coral (Mars)
items.summary: Traditionally worn to support courage, drive, and physical vitality, and to steady relationships with siblings.
items.effects: Traditionally worn to support courage, drive, and physical vitality, and to steady relationships with siblings. Classically suggested for a weak Mars; a strong or already-dominant Mars is usually left alone, since Mars's themes (assertiveness, conflict) aren't ones most traditions want to amplify further.

items.title: Emerald (Mercury)
items.summary: Traditionally worn to sharpen communication, analytical thinking, and business acumen.
items.effects: Traditionally worn to sharpen communication, analytical thinking, and business acumen. Classically suggested for a weak or afflicted Mercury - useful for students, writers, and anyone in communication-heavy or analytical work.

items.title: Yellow Sapphire (Jupiter)
items.summary: Traditionally one of the most favored gemstones to wear at all, since Jupiter is the natural benefic of wisdom, fortune, and growth - supports higher learning, financial stability, marriage prospects, and guidance from teachers.
items.effects: Traditionally one of the most favored gemstones to wear at all, since Jupiter is the natural benefic of wisdom, fortune, and growth - supports higher learning, financial stability, marriage prospects, and guidance from teachers. Classically suggested especially for a weak or afflicted Jupiter.

items.title: Diamond (Venus)
items.summary: Traditionally worn to support love, marriage, artistic expression, comfort, and material refinement.
items.effects: Traditionally worn to support love, marriage, artistic expression, comfort, and material refinement. Classically suggested for a weak or afflicted Venus.

items.title: Blue Sapphire (Saturn)
items.summary: Classically considered the FASTEST-acting and least predictable gemstone - it can bring real relief when it suits the wearer, or intensify Saturn's harder themes (delay, hardship, isolation) when it doesn't.
items.effects: Classically considered the FASTEST-acting and least predictable gemstone - it can bring real relief when it suits the wearer, or intensify Saturn's harder themes (delay, hardship, isolation) when it doesn't. Nearly every traditional source recommends a short trial period (worn briefly first, watched closely) before committing to it, rather than wearing it outright on a recommendation alone.

items.title: Hessonite Garnet (Rahu)
items.summary: Traditionally worn to steady Rahu's restless, ambitious, boundary-pushing themes - support during periods this shadow planet's dasha or transit is prominent.
items.effects: Traditionally worn to steady Rahu's restless, ambitious, boundary-pushing themes - support during periods this shadow planet's dasha or transit is prominent. Rahu/Ketu gemstone guidance is less classically standardized than the 7 classical grahas' (see planet_in_sign.json's own rahu_ketu_dignity_note for the same disclosed disagreement at the dignity level).

items.title: Cat's Eye (Ketu)
items.summary: Traditionally worn to steady Ketu's detached, spiritually-inclined, sometimes disorienting themes - support during periods this shadow planet's dasha or transit is prominent.
items.effects: Traditionally worn to steady Ketu's detached, spiritually-inclined, sometimes disorienting themes - support during periods this shadow planet's dasha or transit is prominent. Same disclosed disagreement across sources as Rahu above.
